name: Devil The
overview: Scripture reveals the Devil as a tempter and adversary who boldly challenges God's authority, as seen when he tests Job's faith by inflicting suffering yet remains under God's sovereign control (Job 2:4-7). In the temptation of Christ, the Devil attempts to entice Him to misuse His divine power, but Christ counters with the truth of God's Word, demonstrating the Devil's role as the deceiver who seeks to lead believers astray (Matthew 4:3-4). These passages emphasize the Devil's persistent opposition to God and His people, yet also highlight God's ultimate authority over him.
